sources.title: AI in scratch (beta) Using Cloud Variables + Python + Local Models ...
sources.snippet: A Python script running on my computer: Reads the cloud variable, Decodes the message, Sends it to a local AI model (phi running through Ollama), Gets the response, Encodes the response back into numbers. Then, the bot updates another cloud variable with the AI's reply. Scratch reads and displays the response — boom, AI chat inside Scratch!
